subject: Tree Ordinance Revision and Energy Festival Review
overview: The committee reviewed the 2023 Harvester Energy Festival outcomes and discussed proposed updates to the municipal tree ordinance. Staff also provided updates on leadership transitions, electric vehicle charging infrastructure, and building codes.

items.title: Administrative Updates
items.summary: Staff confirmed that meeting and webinar recordings will be routinely posted to the city website moving forward.

items.title: Outreach and Events
items.summary: The committee decided to host an outreach table at the city’s Winter Extravaganza on November 29th.

items.title: Committee Leadership Transitions
items.summary: Robert Paine announced he is stepping down as chair; Sarah Singh, Dan Papo, and Will Sherwood expressed interest in chair or co-chair roles for the coming year.

items.title: 2023 Harvester Energy Festival Review
items.summary: Members reviewed the success of the festival, which collected 1,067 pounds of materials and 97 dehumidifiers, while discussing improvements for traffic flow and reducing plastic marketing materials.

items.title: Municipal Energy and Climate Updates
items.summary: Staff reported on the formation of the Climate Equity Council, the progress of seven new EV charging station installations, and the upcoming third reading of the Specialized Energy Code.

items.title: Tree Ordinance Revisions
items.summary: The committee reviewed draft revisions to the public and private tree ordinances and assigned Lauretta James and Lois Grossman to consolidate feedback for the City Council. Discussion focused on concerns regarding the Building Commissioner's proposal to lower removal fees and simplify clear-cutting regulations.
